name: Ooishi Kuwajirou
source:
A member of the Shinsengumi.
He is involved with assassinations and other bloody missions.
He enjoys killing people and hearing that he could kill people for money without being punished he joined the Shinsengumi.
He's always looking down on people and being superficially polite with a fearless smile on his face.
He thinks trusting people is foolish and has no friends.
